title: FlymakSMP
description: A heavy modpack for my smp adds alot of aesthetic stuff
body:
## Flymak SMP – Heavy Modpack

This modpack is used for my smp  
**JOIN HERE** [Discord](https://discord.gg/azqnChr8mG)

---

## 🐾 Mobs & Wildlife
- Red pandas
- Sugar gliders
- Bull sharks
- Gorillas
![More Mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7e43d74e3d0a7568cc4ccdcb3ecd8379c0129f2_0.webp)
---

## 🎨 Visual Enhancements
- Visuality
- Visual Jukebox
- Visual Crafting Table
- Subtle Effects
- Particular
- Many more visual mods

---

## ⚔️ Gameplay & Bosses
- Improved End fight
- Fishing Expansion (adds a new fishing-themed boss)
- Frostiful (cold temperature survival + new armor)

---

## 📸 Fun Additions
- Camerapture (take in-game photos)
- Musical Instruments (create and play music)

---

## ⚙️ Performance
- **Optimised for low-end PCs and laptops**
- Shader support included
